card.name: AUC and confidence interval abbreviations
card.fires_on: The last piece of the abbreviation AUC (the 'UC' after 'A') in pharmacokinetic tables and text. Also the space or 'CI' right before a confidence-interval figure such as 90% or 95%.

modes.label: AUC abbreviation
modes.description: The 'UC' ending of AUC when it is written out beside Cmax or AUC(TAU) definitions.
